notice: Design input only. This file is not policy, authority, runtime routing, an active schema, or a canonical data source.
guardrails: Do not wire these drafts into runtime before the owning reform Stage begins.
A capability may name required policy IDs but may never authorize a side effect.
Unknown data stays unknown or null; do not invent business, printer, cost, reliability, or product facts.
Product Truth remains higher authority than Creative OS presentation choices.
OWNER_REVIEW_CANDIDATE and ready_for_publish remain non-publication states.

stage4_action_review_receipt.purpose: Candidate audit primitive for exact-action human review; policy decision remains canonical and external-effect-specific.
invariants: Missing policy decision cannot be replaced by review.
Receipt must bind the exact subject, action, and artifact set under review.
Open BLOCKER means not approved.
Expiry behavior is explicit; review_at alone never disables a safety policy.

verification_vectors.case: missing policy_decision_ref
reviewer absent or anonymous
open BLOCKER exists

stage5_capability_descriptor.purpose: Inventory and routing metadata only, never policy authority.
invariants: Root AGENTS stays small; domain instructions live closest to the owning package.
Capability selection cannot silently load VF-specific context into unrelated Core tasks.
required_policy_ids are dependencies, not permission.

verification_vectors.case: descriptor contains its own allow or deny decision semantics
VF business facts placed in a generic Core descriptor
consequential action omits its required policy_id

stage6_creative_plan.purpose: Editorial planning contract for presentation only; never physical identity or publication authorization.
invariants: Product Truth sources are distinct from aesthetic references.
No plan field can authorize a physical product change.
Public or external final text remains governed by visible_text.finalization.
CHAT_NATIVE_TERMINAL decisions must be finalized before the terminal image edit.

verification_vectors.case: creative plan adds a physical part absent from the product source
Product Truth QA board used as a style reference
public text changes after its exact-text receipt

stage7_research_route.purpose: Transparent research-method selection without a second scheduled daemon.

route_examples.patent: patent landscape with explicit non-legal status

invariants: No deep review without a signal or explicit high-value request.
A paid-capable route must satisfy the Stage 7C cost policy or envelope.
Research findings cannot self-promote into policy.

verification_vectors.case: supplied document routed to trend pulse
paid research route without cost authorization
finding attempts automatic policy change

stage7_cost_envelope.purpose: Candidate bounded-cost authorization shape; canonical cost policy remains owner.
invariants: NO_NEW_RECURRING_COST remains the default.
Existing subscription is not proof of zero incremental usage cost.
Without a hard cap or overage control, per-call approval remains required.

verification_vectors.case: monthly cap absent on a metered provider
envelope expired
call outside approved scope

stage7_work_ledger_reference.purpose: Continuation and audit index over canonical artifacts and state, not a second artifact store.
invariants: Storage location follows Stage 7D retention classification.
Do not duplicate full transcripts or canonical records.
A ledger entry is context and audit indexing, not policy authority.

verification_vectors.case: ledger copies a canonical policy body and claims authority
large media embedded into Git ledger
record references canonical artifact by hash and location

stage8_printer_capability_record.purpose: Field inventory for a future VF printer registry; intentionally non-canonical until Stage 8 placement.
invariants: VF fleet facts belong to Instance-owned sources.
Unknown dimensions, materials, or profiles remain null.
No printer upload, start, or control authority is implied.
Capacity scheduling starts advisory-only.

verification_vectors.case: missing build volume filled from model guess
verified source ref supports a capability
record is used as authority to start a physical print

stage8_knowledge_record.purpose: Source-grounded derived knowledge with Core and Instance separation.
invariants: Generic technical knowledge and VF-local observations are separated.
Derived knowledge cannot grant policy or owner authorization.
Sensitive or operational live truth follows its existing canonical source.

verification_vectors.case: derived memory conflicts with a current canonical source
VF-local printer fact stored as generic Core truth
